items.definition: Returns divided by orders, as a percent: the share of orders placed in the period that were later returned.
items.sql: SELECT branch, SUM(CASE WHEN returned THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS numerator, COUNT(*) AS denominator, COUNT(*) AS rows_over FROM orders WHERE month IN ('2025-07', '2025-08', '2025-09') GROUP BY branch

items.definition: Revenue divided by orders: the mean order value of the orders placed in the period.
items.sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(order_value) * 100 AS BIGINT) AS numerator, COUNT(*) AS denominator, COUNT(*) AS rows_over FROM orders WHERE month IN ('2025-03')

items.definition: A group's revenue divided by the revenue of every group in the period, as a percent. One dimension is required: the groups are its values.
items.sql: SELECT branch AS group_value, CAST(SUM(order_value) * 100 AS BIGINT) AS value_cents, COUNT(*) AS rows_over FROM orders WHERE month IN ('2025-01', '2025-02', '2025-03', '2025-04', '2025-05', '2025-06', '2025-07', '2025-08', '2025-09', '2025-10', '2025-11', '2025-12') GROUP BY branch

items.label: Profit margin by branch
items.question: What was the profit margin by branch in 2025?

items.message: "profit margin" is not a defined metric, so this system cannot compute it. The nearest defined metric is net_revenue: Revenue minus returned value: the order value of the orders placed in the period that were not returned. The defined metrics are: orders, revenue, returns, returns_rate, returned_value, net_revenue, average_order_value, largest_order, mom_growth, qoq_growth, revenue_share, orders_share.
